steps.title: A garden of discoveries
paragraphs: Kids wander and earn Materials. Try pairs to discover new kinds and fill your Potato-Dex.
Drag empty ground to pan; pinch with two fingers to zoom.

steps.title: Pick up, hover, fuse
paragraphs: Drag a kid over another. Marked partners can fuse: release to turn two kids into one.
The window shows parents and result. Dark means undiscovered. Tap a kid for its card.

steps.title: Know your numbers
paragraphs: Materials pay for buildings, plots, fields, names or Compendium returns. Potatokens buy instant spawns or Compendium returns.
Kids on map shows population / capacity. Tap a number for its name and details.

steps.title: The Garden brings new kids
paragraphs: Open Garden for arrivals, plots, fields and spawn upgrades. New kids arrive over time when there's room.
Garden upgrades shorten the wait. Notebook → Capacity adds room. Spawn now shows its Potatoken cost.

steps.title: Plant for a surprise
paragraphs: Drag kids to the Garden, or tap a plot and pick 3–5. Choose Start growing; filling never starts itself.
One kid sprouts later, sometimes Special or Rare.

steps.title: Farm food, then feed
paragraphs: Tap a field, choose food and assign kids. Farmers fill the Pantry instead of earning Materials.
Open Pantry in Notebook. Feed from a kid's card; the sun means happy.

steps.title: Keep your discoveries
paragraphs: Potato-Dex keeps your discoveries and found recipes. Kids on map lists every wandering kid, including offscreen ones.
Special has a ribbon badge; Rare has a gem and sparkles. Unknown entries stay mysterious.

steps.title: Your Notebook of tools
paragraphs: Notebook holds Pantry, Capacity, Spawn bias, Compendium, Map view and Settings. Hold a control icon to see its name.
Map view has zoom and Find Garden. Settings has sound and motion.

steps.title: A garden of discoveries
steps.body: Discover new kinds of Potato Kid. Fill your Potato-Dex at your own pace.

steps.title: Two kids, one discovery
steps.body: Drag a kid over a marked partner. Release to fuse two kids into one new kid.

steps.title: Keep every discovery
steps.body: Open the Potato-Dex for the kinds and recipes you've found.

items.title: Plant a surprise
items.body: Add 3–5 kids to a plot, then choose Start growing. One surprise kid grows; tap the glowing plot to meet the sprout.

items.title: An arrival without the wait
items.body: Potatokens buy instant Garden arrivals. Spawn now shows the price before spending.

items.title: Shorten the wait
items.body: Kids on the map earn Materials. Garden upgrades spend Materials to shorten the wait between arrivals.

items.title: Room for more kids
items.body: Capacity upgrades spend Materials to make room for more kids on the map.

items.title: A name to keep
items.body: Open a kid's card to buy a nickname with Materials. The name stays until fusion or planting; clearing the name is free.
items.route: Kid card → Name; Potato-Dex → Kids on map

items.title: Choose a Garden favourite
items.body: Build Spawn bias with Materials, then choose a discovered Garden kind. Upgrades make that kind more likely to arrive.

items.title: Grow food
items.body: Buy a field with Materials, choose food, and assign kids. Farmers fill the Pantry instead of earning Materials; take farmers back any time.

items.title: A bite of happiness
items.trigger: exists live kid, food: pantry[food] >= 1 && food != hatedFood(kid.type)
items.body: Feed a kid from the Pantry through the kid's card. Favourites keep happiness longer; happy kids earn more and help planting odds.
items.route: Kid card → Feed; Potato-Dex → Kids on map

items.title: Another planting plot
items.body: Spend Materials on another plot to grow more surprises at once. Each plot still needs 3–5 kids and Start growing.

items.title: Another food field
items.body: Spend Materials on another field to grow more food. Choose food and assign farmers in each field.

items.title: Bring familiar kinds back
items.body: Build the Compendium with Materials to bring discovered ordinary kinds back. Special and Rare kids come only from planting.

items.title: Choose how to pay
items.trigger: compendiumLevel >= 1 && exists discovered ordinary t: (M >= respawnCost(t).materials || P >= respawnCost(t).potatokens)
items.body: A Compendium return costs Materials or Potatokens. Choose one price to bring back one known ordinary kid when there's room.
